cases.name: Separate last cook from base
cases.prompt: My bean salad serves four and uses lime. I used lemon on May 5, liked the brightness, and rated it four stars.
expectations: Keeps lime in the base card.
Records four servings and a 4/5 rating.
Associates brightness with the tasted variation.

cases.name: Find from pasted cards
cases.prompt: My cards say chilli is spicy and stew is savory, both for winter. Show savory winter dishes.
expectations: Returns stew as the matching dish.
Explains the savory and winter tag match.
Does not include chilli merely because it is for winter.
Limits the lookup to the two supplied cards.

cases.name: Preserve unknowns
cases.prompt: Add my favorite noodle dish. I use a handful of basil, but I don't remember the method or quantities yet.
expectations: Marks the dish as a favorite without fabricating stars.
Marks the method and other quantities as missing.
Returns a partial recipe card that can be completed.
